dict.string: RoadPin saves where you are when you drop a pin, and remembers the last stretch of road you drove so "miles back" pins land where you actually were.
Allowing location all the time lets "Hey Siri, drop a RoadPin" save a pin even when RoadPin isn't open.
After you drop a pin, RoadPin listens for a few seconds so you can say what you want to look up later.
RoadPin turns what you say into a short note on the pin, like "large building" or "name of that town".
